title: A Provision for the Escarpment
author: Emrys Hartwell
blurb: Elodie Eastwick, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
